traditional: 將 A 換成好啲嘅 B

boxes.jyutping: zoeng1 A wun6 sing4 hou2 di1 ge3 B

examples.english: We decided to upgrade the old television to a better smart TV, so we would not need repairs so often.
examples.traditional: 我哋將舊電視換成好啲嘅智能電視，唔使再成日維修。
